summary: April brings spring flowers and Easter crowds in Europe, and the hottest weeks of the year in parts of Asia.
intro: Spring is in full swing across Europe and much of North America: tulips in the Netherlands, blossom moving north through Japan, and mild days for walking before the summer heat. Easter usually falls in late March or April, and with it come school holidays and higher prices.

In South and South-East Asia April is often the hottest month before the monsoon, and the time of New Year water festivals in Thailand. In the southern hemisphere autumn begins, with cooler days and changing leaves.
